invariants.observableFact: The Collection UI reads as one centered, rounded cream card with a dark hand-drawn outline, a green COLLECTION ribbon, and restrained leaf decoration over a neutral backdrop.
The modal preserves the approved top-to-bottom hierarchy: collection banner, variant name, produce preview, difficulty display, state/status region, and primary action.
The preview contains ten representative fruit layers arranged as one dense, overlapping produce mass inside a single wide rounded box, rather than as separated icons or a thumbnail grid.
Large fruit forms anchor the upper preview while smaller overlapping fruit forms consolidate the lower edge; edge cropping contributes to a continuous, full produce-box composition.
Every preview fruit is rendered from an actual sprite without aspect-ratio distortion or unintended opacity change.
Collection navigation provides exactly one previous control and one next control, both outside the clipped page content, and provides no BackAction in either the modal body or title banner.
The cream, green, orange, and dark-outline visual language remains cohesive across the banner, typography, preview frame, difficulty indicator, navigation controls, and action.

default.observableFact: The variant name is displayed as DEFAULT FRUIT.
The difficulty display communicates difficulty 1; in the approved rating language, one rating mark is emphasized and the remaining marks are inactive.
The Default preview preserves the approved ten-layer produce-mass arrangement, including dominant melons above and overlapping smaller fruit across the lower portion.

pixel.observableFact: The variant name is displayed as PIXEL FRUIT.
The difficulty display communicates difficulty 2; when using the approved rating language, two rating marks are emphasized and the remaining mark is inactive.
The Pixel preview uses actual Pixel-variant sprites while retaining the approved ten-layer, overlapping produce-box composition; it is not required to reproduce Default artwork literally.

active.observableFact: The primary action label reads IN USE.
The action and its surrounding presentation visibly use the active-set styling.
The IN USE action is non-interactable.

unlockedSelectable.observableFact: The primary action label reads USE THIS SET.
The action and its surrounding presentation visibly use the selectable-set styling and are distinguishable from the active state.
The USE THIS SET action is interactable.

wholeFrameChecks.observableFact: On Xiaomi 23043RP34G running package com.joewrks.mergedrop.visual version 0.1.3 (4), the full modal—including its outer decoration, banner, preview, metadata, and primary action—is visible in the review frame without edge clipping.
At whole-frame scale, the modal remains the dominant centered element with clear surrounding backdrop and an immediately readable banner-to-action hierarchy.
The title, produce mass, difficulty display, state/status region, and action remain visually separated and legible, with no overlap that obscures content.
The produce preview remains the principal visual focus of the modal while the previous and next controls remain visibly associated with navigation without displacing or obscuring the preview.

focusedChecks.observableFact: In a focused header inspection, COLLECTION is legible on the green ribbon and the current variant name is centered beneath it with the correct Default or Pixel text.
In a focused preview inspection, ten discernible fruit layers overlap into one continuous produce mass, including purposeful edge crops and no unintended empty gaps that fragment the composition.
In a focused sprite inspection, each fruit retains its source proportions and intended opacity and shows no stretching, squashing, or unintended translucency.
In a focused navigation inspection, one previous and one next control are present, remain outside the clipped page content, and are not clipped themselves; no BackAction is present.
In a focused difficulty inspection, the emphasized rating count matches the displayed variant: one for Default and two for Pixel.
In a focused action inspection, active and unlocked-selectable renders differ in label, styling, and interaction availability exactly as defined by their respective state checks.

unverifiedBoundaries.observableFact: Explicit user acceptance is a separate evidence layer and remains unverified by agent-observable visual and interaction checks.

The approved Default reference does not specify literal Pixel labels, artwork, difficulty, or state; exact Pixel artwork identity and arrangement beyond the shared composition and cited Pixel metadata remain unverified.

No exact numeric coordinates, margins, dimensions, corner radii, font metrics, or color values are established by the composition reference; candidate-derived coordinates cannot serve as acceptance authority.
Locked, unavailable, loading, error, transition, and other states beyond active and unlocked-selectable have no cited acceptance semantics and remain unverified.
The authorities establish action interactability and navigation structure but do not establish animation, transition timing, gesture behavior, or numeric touch-target requirements.

Rendering on devices, orientations, packages, or versions other than Xiaomi 23043RP34G with com.joewrks.mergedrop.visual version 0.1.3 (4) is outside the named acceptance target and remains unverified.
